raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Experienced Network Design Engineer with strong expertise in enterprise WAN/LAN design, routing protocols, and customer-facing service delivery. Proven ability to manage end-to-end MACD activities, network migrations, and technical change execution while ensuring compliance with enterprise standards. excelling in advanced routing and switching, network design, Proven track record in troubleshooting complex network issues Skilled in Cisco-based network configurations, troubleshooting, and customer communication, with a focus on delivering reliable and scalable network solutions, ensuring high availability and performance across multi-vendor environments.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
SENIOR NETWORK DESIGN ENGINEERING
AT&T | Aug 2025 – Present
Design, configure, and implement enterprise network solutions for customer environments, ensuring scalable and reliable
architecture aligned with business needs.
Handle Two Service Line (ADI & AVPN ) MACD activities including IP migrations, routing updates, and service
modifications with minimal customer impact.
Configure and troubleshoot routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF on Cisco routers and switches.
Manage end-to-end ticket lifecycle, ensuring compliance with SLA timelines and AT&T operational standards.
Coordinate with customers and internal teams for change scheduling, maintenance windows, and issue resolution.
Perform detailed network analysis and troubleshooting to identify root causes and resolve connectivity/performance
issues.
Support implementation of MPLS and enterprise WAN solutions for large-scale customer deployments.
Provide customer-facing communication including technical updates, change notifications, and incident summaries.
NETWORK ENGINEER
Prodapt Solutions Private Ltd | JUN-2024- AUG-2025
Expertise in Vayaata & BIB Router architectures, strong understanding of network virtualization, L2/L3 protocols,
VLAN, BGP, OSPF, multicast, and overall data centre networking design.
Led end-to-end troubleshooting and resolution of network incidents within SLA, including routing, and QoS-related
challenges across Cisco and Juniper platforms.
Performed iOS upgrades, LAN & WAN Changes on Cisco routers and switches, including pre/post-upgrade validation,
backup, rollback planning, and minimal downtime execution in production environments.
• Hands-on experience with Cisco devices including NCS540/560, ASR920/901, ISR4331 with expertise in software
upgrades and downgrades.
NETWORK OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE
BHARTI AIRTEL LTD | AUG 2021 – JUN 2024
Expert in configuring and troubleshooting Juniper BRAS platforms, including MX Series edge routers (MX480, MX960),
ensuring reliable broadband access and high-performance service delivery.

Involved in mix of operational, Change Management & Fault Management.

Implemented, developed, tested, and troubleshot L2 and L3 VPN IMS services within CEN/MPLS and ISP backbone networks, ensuring high availability and seamless service delivery.
LAN/WAN support, VLAN configuration, and IP addressing, performance optimization, and outage resolution.
Experience with network monitoring tools (SNMP, ping, traceroute, Wireshark).
Network security best practices, access control, and incident response, regular network health checks and preventive
maintenance.
Backup and recovery planning for network configurations.
Network documentation and coordination with ISPs/vendors.
NETWORK FIELD ENGINEER
Teleindia Networks Pvt Ltd | DEC 2020 – JUL 2021

Hardware Deployment: Install, configure, and rack-mount routers, switches, firewalls.
Cabling & Fiber Optics: Manage structured cabling, fiber splicing, termination, and patch cord management for structured
networks.
Network Troubleshooting: Conduct physical site surveys, perform power meter testing, and resolve network outages and
latency issues.
System Testing: Execute acceptance testing, integrate new devices, and certify connectivity for voice, video, and data
networks.
On-Site Support: Collaborate with remote network architects and project managers to deploy upgrades and provide post-
implementation support
